Business and trade disclosures

The legal form, company register number and court (if registered), VAT ID (if assigned), trade/supervisory authority, chamber membership and applicable professional rules must still be supplied or confirmed as inapplicable by the operator.

Editorial policy

Information about tool and equipment rental and related services by Alles Saniert. The service primarily addresses private customers; businesses and associations may also inquire.

Controller and contact

Willy Schröder, Fotzebenweg 3, 2763 Pernitz, Austria. Privacy inquiries: office@allessaniert.at.

Contact and rental inquiries

We process the submitted name, email, optional phone number and message, plus the equipment, requested dates and server-calculated price for rental inquiries. The purpose is handling your inquiry and possible pre-contractual steps (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR), or general communication based on legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). Required fields are identified on the form; without them the inquiry cannot be processed. Acknowledging this notice is not consent to marketing.

Rental inquiries are stored in the backend. Contact messages are sent through the configured email service. The operator must still confirm the providers, locations, retention periods and processing agreements. Automated deletion is not configured; a fixed six-month retention period is therefore not promised.

Operation and abuse prevention

Technical connection data is processed to deliver the site. Public submissions are rate limited. The hosting provider, actual server logs, retention and possible international transfers must be disclosed before publication. Application code does not establish that hosting logs are anonymised.

Cloudflare Turnstile is included on the contact form when a website key is configured. This creates connections to Cloudflare. The legal basis, provider information, processing agreement and possible international transfers must be assessed before activation. No website key is currently configured.

Local preferences and analytics

Your consent choice is stored as as_cookie_consent_v2 for 180 days. Explicitly selected language and theme are stored locally; the return page from cookie settings is stored only for the session. You may clear these entries in your browser. Search terms and form entries are not saved in local storage.

Optional Google analytics loads only when IDs are configured and prior consent is given (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR; section 165(3) Austrian TKG 2021). No analytics IDs are currently configured. Before activation, provider details, purposes, cookie durations, recipients and transfer safeguards must be completed. Withdraw consent at any time in Cookie settings. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Your rights

Subject to the GDPR, you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and may withdraw consent. You can complain to the Austrian Data Protection Authority. Rental contracts are not decided by automated processing.

When you explicitly switch language, current form entries may be transferred temporarily through session storage. They are read once and removed on the destination page, and are not restored after ten minutes.

Necessary local preferences remember your consent and explicitly selected language and theme. The site uses no external fonts.

Optional analytics is off by default. Without configured Google IDs, Google tracking is not loaded. After consent and configuration, Google Tag Manager or Google Analytics may load; the implementation avoids starting both for the same setup.

Consent expires after 180 days. Invalid or old grants do not enable tracking. Withdrawal clears accessible Google analytics cookies and reloads the document to stop loaded trackers. This website cannot itself remove third-party cookies on other domains.

Open Cookie settings · Privacy notice

Our technical target is WCAG 2.2 AA. Navigation, search, forms and theme selection support keyboard use and visible focus indicators. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.

Automated checks do not replace a complete assessment with assistive technology. Full conformance is not guaranteed. The Austrian BaFG’s applicability depends on the actual consumer service and any microenterprise exemption, which remain to be confirmed.

Report accessibility problems to office@allessaniert.at, including the affected page and assistive technology used.

Existing image-source records are retained in the project documentation. The operator must confirm publication rights for each photograph and manufacturer image from the original licence and provenance records.

Benefit icons use existing local images. Navigation uses system symbols without an external icon font. Optimised WebP files derive from existing photos and do not create new rights.

aboutContent:
Our story

Willy Schröder started training as an electromechanic and mechanical engineer in 1980, discovering his interest in quality tools.

The family business began in 2004. Building a home in the Piesting valley inspired a passion for professional equipment.

In 2008 this became Alles Saniert: making quality tools available to others through rental. Renting saves space, reduces costs and conserves resources.

Tools should be used rather than left gathering dust in a workshop, basement or garage.

Our services

We offer tool rental, advice and practical support for projects around the home, garden and woodland.

  • Tool rental: equipment for indoor and outdoor work.
  • Building materials: advice and suitable materials for lasting results.
  • Forestry: maintenance, thinning and professional pruning.
forestryContent:
Forestry care for private land, gardens and small woodlands in the Piesting valley, supporting safety and healthy growth.

Our services

Small-scale tree removal

Safe, professional tree removal for gardens and smaller woodlands.

Reforestation

We help choose species suited to your site and establish sustainable planting.

Young woodland and protection

Care for young trees and targeted pest-control measures to support stable, healthy growth.

Tree and shrub care

Hedge trimming and fruit-tree pruning for healthy and well-maintained plants.

Small-scale timber harvesting

Modern equipment for efficient harvesting in private woodlands and smaller projects.
